subject: Security intake & evidence sprint — next steps

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-11-29T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Security intake & evidence sprint — next steps

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Demo takeaway: Astral is primarily evaluating low-latency generation for analytics assistants; there are a couple integrations that may touch PHI (we noted HIPAA scope).
- Immediate asks from your security team: copy of the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), any bridge/interim attestation you can share, and read-only access to a secure evidence area (S3/signed link or your portal).

Proposed timeline:
- Portal/secure share credentials by EOD Tue (2025-12-02)
- SOC 2 Type II report (or link) by end of week (2025-12-05)
- 30-min intake call (security) — Wed 2025-12-03 at 10am PT if that works for your team

If helpful, we can also send our short vendor DDQ (10 fields) to speed triage — happy to accept a completed copy of your own questionnaire instead.

I'll attach the demo deck for reference and to help your team map features to controls. If HIPAA is in-scope for those integrations, flag it here and we'll route to our Privacy lead during the intake call.

Thanks — looking forward to closing the loop.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
